# openmetadata_messaging_service (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Messaging Service by name. Connection credentials are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_messaging_service" "example" {
  name = "MyMessagingService"
}

output "service_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_messaging_service.example.id
}

output "service_type" {
  value = data.openmetadata_messaging_service.example.service_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the service.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Domains this service belongs to.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name.
- `id` (String) UUID of the service.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `service_type` (String) Type of messaging service (e.g. Kafka, Kinesis, PubSub, Redpanda).

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
